text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Agreement imminent between Israel and the Palestinians on withdrawal from Hebron.

- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri held a big ministerial meeting yesterday to prepare for the Middle East and North Africa economic meeting. After the meeting Information Minister Safwat el-Sherif said that 99 states had agreed to take part, along with about 3,000 businessmen and representatives of banks and other institutions.
- Defence Minister Mohamed Hussein Tantawi yesterday received Italian Defence Minister Beniamino Andreatta, who is on a private visit for celebrations of the end of World War Two.
- President Hosni Mubarak will today receive Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi, who is in Cairo for one day for talks on the peace process in the Middle East.

- Ganzouri said Egypt has been able to address the world in its own language by providing the right environment for a national economy which is capable of coping with international markets and trading blocs.
- Education Minister Hussein Kamel Bahaeddin said the government was doing everything possible to ensure the success of the private universities in carrying out their mission.

- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid announced that the final measures are now under way to prepare seven companies to sale to anchor investors by the end of December. They are Metalco/Egyptian Metallic Constructions, Steelco/Engineering Steelworks Projects, Delta Industrial (IDEAL), Stia/Nasr Woollen and Selected Textiles NWEP.CA, Middle East Paper, Nasr Glass and Crystal, and Misr Milk and Food.

The minister also said that during the same period shares in six companies will be offered for sale through the stock exchange. These include: Damietta Container Handling, Egyptian Electro Cables, Paints and Chemical Industries/PACHIN, Egypt Free Shops and General Egyptian Warehouses.

- Seventeen terrorists have been referred to trial in the Supreme State Security Court for killing a police colonel and other policemen, attacking cinemas and a tourist bus in Old Cairo, and throwing bombs at the police in Helwan.
- Ganzouri discusses preparations for the economic conference in November.
- 59 luxury cars smuggled through customs in one month.
